notes.title: Blackheart: Pricing Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!

I can't believe it's already been over 7 months since we launched Blackheart! Making this game was a huge undertaking - especially as our studio's first title. While we are incredibly proud of the game we've produced, sales have been underwhelming. We had a great new influx of players during the Steam Summer Sale, and this was an indication to us that a lower price tag may attract more players to try it out. As a result, we are reducing the price to $6.99 USD (That's around 11 bucks for our fellow kiwis).

Thanks so much to everyone who's purchased the game and left reviews so far - your support has been super encouraging. Here's hoping we can get a few more players on board and continue to grow Blackheart's fan base!

-Josiah[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 2 - electric boogaloo
notes.notes:
Fixed a softlock where the player could miss the narrative progression zone early in act 1 and be unable to gift the dull sigil to Abigail back in Credoss.
Also made some minor adjustments to some of the visual elements inside Credoss.
Shoutout to community members lolyay270 and Busk for the bug reports!

notes.title: Day 1 hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed some broken geometry in Credoss that allowed the player to break out of the playable space.

notes.title: Blackheart Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hi Blackhearts!

I'm excited to say that Blackheart will be launching on 30 October 2024! It has been a long and difficult road to finish this dream game of ours, but we have finally arrived. Thank you all for being so patient, and I can't wait for you to immerse yourselves in this perilous world we have created.

See you on October 30!

-Josiah
